crime: The girl began meeting {WITCH_NAME} in the recreation room for evening films. They took turns choosing what to watch, and both stayed until each film ended. At first, the girl always sat through {WITCH_NAME}'s choices.
After growing close to her cellmate, the girl began leaving {WITCH_NAME}'s films halfway through without warning to spend time with the cellmate instead.

On the day of the murder, the girl privately messaged her cellmate that she would watch one last film with {WITCH_NAME} and tell {WITCH_NAME} in person that she would not come again. Halfway through the film {WITCH_NAME} had chosen, the girl switched off the projector and said she would not return.
When the girl failed to meet her cellmate afterward, the cellmate went to the recreation room and found the girl strangled beside the projector.

Several short threads caught between the girl's teeth matched a fresh tear in {WITCH_NAME}'s collar. Within the bruises around the girl's neck was a fresh bite on the side of her neck, beyond the reach of her own mouth. Its tooth pattern matched the girl's teeth, while {WITCH_NAME} had no corresponding bite.

The cellmate then showed the prisoners the private message from before the viewing. It named {WITCH_NAME} and said the girl would end their shared viewings that evening. {WITCH_NAME} had not known the message existed.

While {WITCH_NAME} strangled the girl, the girl bit her attacker's neck and collar. {WITCH_NAME} used Returned Wounds to make the bite appear in the same place on the girl's neck instead, leaving herself unmarked, and then finished strangling the girl. The unreachable bite exposed the magic, the threads linked it to the torn collar, and the private message proved who the girl had gone to meet that night.
fields.epitaph: She could send every wound back. No one came back with it.
execution: An enormous iron hand stands open toward her. She is bound upright before its palm, within reach of all five fingers.

The hand closes gently around her once, then opens and withdraws without hurting her. Her bound hands stretch toward the retreating palm as her shoulders tilt forward. Before she can touch it, the hand returns and closes again.
It repeats the motion, gripping harder each time. The fingers pin her arms and ribs against the palm. Each new grip crushes her chest further and compresses her body inside the fist.
At last, the hand stays closed around her crushed, motionless corpse.

magic.name: Returned Wounds
magic.text: When someone injures her, she can make the same injury appear in the same place on that person's body instead.
